notes.title: v1.0.1 update (1/3/2025)
notes.notes:
We noticed some players were just barely escaping death during some sequences. This would cause the player to get stuck, as the game already expects the player to be eliminated.

We had two options: either tighten up the sequences to confirm the elimination of the player, or reward the player for "defeating" our elimination sequence.

We went with the reward instead. Going forward, if you just barely avoid death, instead of being stuck:

[list]
[*] You will be able to move again after a few seconds
[*] Unlock an achievement
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
